build_levenshtein_translation_task: build a Levenshtein Transformer translation task with configurable noise injection for iterative sequence generation
inject_noise_random_delete: inject random deletion noise into target tokens preserving bos and eos special tokens
inject_noise_random_mask: inject random mask noise by replacing random target tokens with the unknown token
build_iterative_refinement_generator: build an IterativeRefinementGenerator for decoding with beam search and external reranking support
run_train_step_with_noise: run a training step that injects noise into target tokens before computing loss and backpropagating
